rules.title: 2026 path-of-travel valuation threshold: $209,208
rules.plain_english: For 2026 the state 'valuation threshold' is $209,208. rules.title: At or below the threshold, path-of-travel spending is capped at 20% of adjusted construction cost
rules.plain_english: If the adjusted construction cost is at or below the valuation threshold ($209,208 in 2026), you do not have to spend more than 20% of that cost on path-of-travel upgrades. Example: a $150,000 adjusted cost means up to $30,000 of path-of-travel work, spent in the priority order.

verification_meta.method: Every rule (all 104) was checked against its source_location after a fresh fetch on 2026-11-25 into a new directory; the writer's downloads were not reused. Fetched: LADBS CL-BC-2026-026, -027, -032 and -036, the LADBS Counter Plan Check Correction Sheet (rev. 4-3-2026) and its 2020 version, LADBS PC/DAD/App.20; City of San Diego Form DS-2123 (January 2026), the 2015 Accessibility Guide for Small Businesses, the Treasurer btaxfees and btaxhow pages, the Ask a CASp page, the 2025 SDCCD Special Use Permit and the 2024 surf RFP; the CSLB-hosted CCDA parking guide; and eCFR full text as of 2026-11-23 for 28 CFR parts 35, 36 and 85, 24 CFR parts 100 and 180 and 36 CFR part 1191 via the eCFR versioner API. The www.ecfr.gov/current HTML pages redirect to a bot check (unblock.federalregister.gov), which was not bypassed; the same text came from the versioner API. eCFR version history was pulled for 24 CFR 180.671, 28 CFR 85.5 and 36 CFR part 1191. PDF text was extracted per page with pdftotext. Every verbatim_quote was string-matched against the fresh text after whitespace, quote and dash normalization, and all 104 matched on the page named in source_location. Two matched only after normalization: San Diego DS-2123 splits '11B-' and '202.4' across a line, and eCFR 203.9 spaces '28 m 2' differently. Every parameter number, date, citation and applies_to scope was read against the source text, and numbers not printed in the source were traced to arithmetic or unit conversion (for example 98 in = 8 ft 2 in, and 2024-02-13 = after February 12, 2024). Statuses: confirmed means the official source in source_location states the rule and its parameters. corrected means a value, date, formula, citation, scope or plain_english statement was changed to match the text. unverifiable means the decisive figure is not shown in any current official text that could be read. refuted means contradicted by the source; none were. The CBC (Title 24 Part 2), Civil Code 1938 and 55.53, and Gov. Code 4467 were not readable (codes.iccsafe.org and dgs.ca.gov are unreachable; leginfo.legislature.ca.gov blocks automated access and was not bypassed). CBC rules are therefore confirmed against the 2026 LADBS and San Diego restatements and the section numbers they cite, and Civil Code 1938 rules against official City of San Diego documents applying the statute. All ids start with 'ada-'; none duplicate an id in tradecomply/data/rulebook.json, and all categories already exist there.
